newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends lower on timely rains, CBOT slide.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends lower on timely rains, CBOT slide.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed lower on crop-enhancing rainfall in the south-west hard red winter belt, traders said.
A late fund-related technical break in CBOT wheat also contributed to the declines, they said.
"It was a light volume day and the break in Chicago took us down further," a trader said.
Traders said the KCBT market already had been weakened by rainy weather in portions of the U.S. Great Plains hard red winter wheat region.
"Rain continues to develop in the Plains," the trader said.
KCBT wheat closed five to nine cents per bushel lower, with May down nine at $4.05 and new crop July ended nine lower aqt $3.81-1/4.
